summary: Emerson Electric Co. filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement for a €750 million offering of 4.000% Notes due 2032, issued by the company as issuer. The notes were priced at 99.639% of par for proceeds of roughly €744.5 million before expenses, with a 0.375% underwriting discount, maturing November 13, 2032, and interest accruing from November 13, 2026, payable annually. Joint book-running managers include J.P. Morgan, Citigroup, BofA Securities, Goldman Sachs, HSBC, Barclays, BNP Paribas, Deutsche Bank and Wells Fargo. This is a routine investment-grade debt shelf takedown, not a special situation; no equity, deal or arbitrage angle applies.
